s1.syndrome_frame: Jaw pain and tooth mobility with radiographic evidence of a unilocular radiolucent lesion
salient_findings: Tender percussion of the right mandibular second premolar and first molar
Slight mobility of the affected teeth
Buccolingual expansion with cortical thinning on cone beam CT
key_facts: Pain and slight mobility of the mandibular right second premolar and first molar
Slight mobility of the affected teeth
Bony-hard consistency of the buccal and lingual cortices
Lesion extends to the superior border of the inferior alveolar nerve canal
Cone beam CT shows buccolingual expansion with cortical thinning

shortlist.label: Odontogenic keratocyst
shortlist.why_kept: Unilocular radiolucent lesion with buccolingual expansion and cortical thinning

shortlist.label: Unicystic ameloblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Irregular shape of the radiolucent lesion and extension to the superior border of the inferior alveolar nerve canal

shortlist.label: Radicular cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Tender percussion of both teeth and slight mobility of the affected teeth

shortlist.label: Dentigerous cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Unilocular radiolucent lesion associated with the apices of the teeth

shortlist.label: Aneurysmal bone cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Bony-hard consistency of the buccal and lingual cortices and mucosal integrity intact

raw.rationale: The unilocular radiolucent lesion with buccolingual expansion and cortical thinning, as well as its irregular shape, is more characteristic of an odontogenic keratocyst, especially given its extension to the superior border of the inferior alveolar nerve canal and the patient's age.

rejected.label: Unicystic ameloblastoma
rejected.why: While possible, unicystic ameloblastoma tends to be more commonly associated with impacted teeth and may have a more variable radiographic appearance.

rejected.label: Radicular cyst
rejected.why: The lesion's irregular shape and buccolingual expansion are atypical for a routine periapical cyst or granuloma, making radicular cyst less likely.

rejected.label: Dentigerous cyst
rejected.why: Dentigerous cysts are typically associated with the crown of an unerupted tooth, which is not indicated in this case.

rejected.label: Aneurysmal bone cyst
rejected.why: Aneurysmal bone cysts often present with more pronounced expansion and may have a soap-bubble appearance radiographically, which does not match the description provided.
